description: This Java class implements a singleton pattern for managing a global instance of NotificationCompat.Builder in an Android wearable application. It provides static methods to set and retrieve the global NotificationCompat.Builder instance, facilitating notification updates across various components of the app.

classes.name: GlobalNotificationBuilder
classes.description: A utility class following the singleton design pattern to manage a single global instance of NotificationCompat.Builder, allowing for consistent notification updates within the app.

methods.name: setNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Sets the static global NotificationCompat.Builder instance to the provided builder.

methods.name: getNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current static global NotificationCompat.Builder instance.
